description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

BAE Systems is a defense, aerospace, and security company that develops technologies and solutions supporting national security. The Entry Level Software Engineer will join the ES Defense software engineering team, working across disciplines throughout the software life cycle on coding, debugging, integration, and testing of complex software and hardware systems.
Entry-level software engineer coding, debugging, integrating, and testing complex software-hardware systems

Responsibilities:
• Tasks may include coding, debugging, and integrating software, as well as the integration, regression, and requirement testing of complex SW/HW systems
• Explore different projects and technologies by participating in rotations
• Develop skills by receiving immediate mentorship from experienced managers and engineers and participate in classes and workshops to expand your knowledge of yourself, technology and our company
• Network and collaborate to make lasting connections with peers, co-workers and leadership

Requirements:
• This position is open to applicants with varying levels of experience. To be considered for an Engineer I, you must have at least a bachelor's degree. To be considered for an Engineer II, you must have a master's degree. Degree in CS (Computer Science), CE (Computer Engineering), or other Scientific degree with suitable software engineering content
• Proficiency in multiple high level programming languages (e.g. C, C++, Java, Python)
• Working knowledge of software design and code utilizing Object Oriented Analysis & Design (OOAD) technique
• Must be eligible for a US DoD security clearance

Preferred:
• Operating Systems (e.g. Windows and/or UNIX/Linux)
• Software version control tools (e.g., Git, Bitbucket)
• Security clearance (Secret or higher)
